The BSc (Hons) Business Management offers students the opportunity to develop a career with global possibilities. BSc (Hons) Business Management Degree exposes students to key concepts in areas such as people management, business law, marketing, strategic management, information systems and big data, project management, finance and innovation and enterprise. This undergraduate course will equip students to enter a range of business roles in the public and private sectors.

In addition to nurturing academic and sector specific knowledge, the programme aims to support students' development of key employability skills, such as critical thinking, problem solving and data analysis. This BSc (Hons) Business Management course is designed to provide a broad understanding of business functions within the business and commercial world. Students will also have the opportunity to transfer to individual pathways in specific areas of business if they wish. The 3 year course offers students a route into general management as well as specialist areas, such as business accounting and finance, enterprise, human resource management, business law, marketing, retail or supply chain management. Overall, this type of Bachelor’s degree aims to give students an essential appreciation of the skills needed to thrive and adapt in the changing world of work.

This three-year BSc (Hons) Computer Science program will support students in gaining all the practical and problem-solving skills they will need to excel in this constantly evolving and highly rewarding field.

This course is designed to develop an in-depth understanding of the theory, design and implementation of algorithms for manipulating data and information. Students would gain a broad education in computer science, with a focus on problem-solving, developing solutions using software and managing the process of innovation.

Throughout the course, the student will apply appropriate theory, tools and methodologies to develop effective solutions, while building the skills needed to adapt and learn new technologies as the computer industry evolves.

By the end of the course, students will be well prepared for success in employment or further study.

Distinctive Features of the Program :

  • The Computing program has been designed collaboratively working with industrial partners to ensure that students study a comprehensive program of relevant industrial topics.
  • A flexible program of study with the ability to specialize in specific career-oriented pathways in the second half of the program.
  • The success of the graduates is directly related to the practical aspects covered in the course laboratory work.

The three-year BSc (Hons) Health and Social Care degree is designed to prepare students to make a positive impact on the daily lives of vulnerable people.

Delivered in excellent teaching facilities, the undergraduate programme provides opportunities for students to develop the values, practical skills and knowledge required for a successful career in the global health and social care sector.

Led by a highly experienced and dedicated teaching team, the programme explores key principles including professional values, ethical care practices, the promotion of physical and mental health, safeguarding, and the advocacy of diversity and inclusion. Its focus is on developing knowledgeable, compassionate and person-centred care professionals.

The BSc (Hons) Health and Social Care provides a strong academic pathway for students preparing to enter the health and social care workplace or progress to further study in a related academic or professional area.

The second year includes a placement module, giving students the opportunity to gain practical experience in a health and social care setting. The module focuses on the development of generic competencies, while enabling students to gain an understanding of workplace functions and structures. During the placement, students are required to maintain a written reflective log and are supported by a tutor who helps them demonstrate the learning gained through their practical experience.

The placement module is linked to an employability module, which focuses on transferable skills and career planning. This enables students to consider their personal and professional development throughout the programme and to prepare for future employment opportunities.

In the final year, students can expand their knowledge in specific areas of health and social care that are of particular interest to them. Available modules include children and families, mental health and safeguarding. These options provide insight into potential areas of specialisation and support the development of deeper knowledge and understanding.

The programme also includes a module examining vulnerability in relation to people who use health and social care services. Compassionate, person-centred care is considered throughout the degree, alongside the principles and practices required to support individuals effectively.

Students will also study research methods and approaches in health and social care. This includes the development of a research proposal, which will provide the foundation for the final research project or dissertation. This work enables students to develop knowledge and understanding in an area of personal interest, while preparing them for postgraduate study and demonstrating academic skills that can be applied in the workplace.

Learning through case studies, workshops and role play is embedded throughout the programme. These activities enable students to explore how theoretical and academic learning connects with practice in the health and social care sector.

The programme is designed to enable students to specialise in International Business Law, equipping them with a comprehensive and critical understanding of the legal processes governing international business transactions. It covers key areas such as trade law, corporate governance, employment law, and international alternative dispute resolution, while also deepening knowledge of law as an academic discipline. Students develop an understanding of legal methods, concepts, and the broader social, political, and theoretical contexts in which legal systems operate.

The course enhances professional development by broadening students’ perspectives and strengthening their ability to analyse complex legal, economic, cultural, ethical, and political issues in a transnational context. It fosters advanced research and writing skills applicable across a wide range of sectors, including legal practice, policymaking, corporate environments, government, and academia. Students are trained to apply their knowledge creatively and systematically to address challenges in global trade and corporate governance, while building high-level transferable skills, critical self-awareness, and effective problem-solving and decision-making abilities.

A distinctive feature of the programme is its international focus, allowing students to develop advanced expertise in International Business Law alongside strategies for personal and professional growth. Teaching is delivered by experienced academic and industry professionals with strong links to public, private, and enterprise sectors. Students have the opportunity to undertake a traditional dissertation to further develop subject expertise, as well as attend guest lectures from leading specialists, providing valuable insight into contemporary professional practice. Employability skills are embedded throughout the curriculum to align with current industry demands.

Upon completion, graduates demonstrate a systematic understanding of key principles, practices, and emerging issues in International Business Law, as well as the employability skills required for career progression. They gain knowledge of the historical and ongoing influence of English law, the UN Convention on Contracts for the International Sale of Goods (CISG), and the regulatory framework of the World Trade Organization (WTO). Students also develop an understanding of the effectiveness and impact of legal mechanisms governing international trade, commercial transactions, and dispute resolution, alongside awareness of the ethical, social, and cultural contexts in which law operates.

The programme also develops advanced cognitive and intellectual skills, enabling students to critically analyse complex legal issues and apply sound judgement in evaluating contractual and trade mechanisms. Graduates are able to assess competing legal arguments, identify potential disputes, and interpret decisions from courts, arbitral bodies, and international organisations. They demonstrate critical awareness of the relationships between international, regional, and domestic legal frameworks, as well as the ability to conduct independent research with originality and authority. The programme culminates in the development of sophisticated analytical, evaluative, and innovative capabilities at Master’s level.

The MSc International Management Degree is designed to help aspiring managers prepare for employment in a wide range of careers and offers enthralling insight into global business perspectives. The course is ideal for individuals seeking to obtain roles within Global, Public and Private Sector Companies.

The course offers a comprehensive overview of global management theories and practices and the opportunity to gain an in depth understanding of the different national and cultural contexts in which firms operate, whilst developing and enhancing analytical and research skills. The course includes a range of relevant subject areas in corporate strategy, international human resource management, sustainability, business innovation as well as finance and accounting that is aimed at developing the necessary knowledge, management and decision making skills that can be applied to international settings. The breadth of topics, combined with an international perspective, prepares students for a variety of roles in an increasingly globalised job market. Being intellectually stimulating and challenging, the course opens up career development opportunities as well as the opportunity to enhance their knowledge and career prospects in areas of further study. The Masters Degree in International Management will give graduates the opportunity to explore a global career in management and to work with International Organizations. This course is designed to prepare students for a variety of management roles across a range of sectors and variety of organisations. This may be within the private, public or voluntary sector, or a multinational company or SME.

MSc Social Care, Health and Wellbeing degree offers an excellent opportunity to gain an advanced understanding of the health and social care sector, as well as areas such as equality, diversity, and collaboration. This MSc Social Care, Health and Wellbeing degree will give students an advanced awareness and understanding of the health and social care sector and the challenges that it faces. Specialist modules will broaden students' understanding of key areas such as equality and diversity, integration, and collaboration. Students will also develop enhanced critical and evaluative awareness of the current and emerging issues within health and social care practice.

Students who have qualified, they will have gained specific academic knowledge and practical skills that can be applied in their existing or future career. Alongside this, the college will help students build lifelong learning skills that they can reflect on, articulate, and translate into everyday life. The MSc in Social Care, Health and Wellbeing is well recognised qualification that provides the opportunity to develop students' knowledge for an existing role, improve their prospects, or make a career change. It can also be a first step towards an academic career. This qualification can take students into many different fields – both in the UK and abroad – including multi-agency teams, health promotion projects, refugee and asylum services, hospitals, sheltered accommodation, hospices, day centres, and residential care units. Graduates of this programme may also choose to progress to study at doctorate-level in health and social care, or a related field.

Gain a deeper understanding of advanced software methodologies with the MSc Software Engineering degree. Students will be able to analyse advanced software development and recognise resources required for Software Engineering once they have graduated. Jobs directly related to a Software Engineering degree include games, systems and web development, search engine optimization, information systems management, web design and business analysis. This degree also ensures that students can have access and exposure to the latest techniques alongside practical skills.

After graduating with an MSc Software Engineering Degree, students will have stimulated their levels of creative thinking and enhanced their problem solving and decision-making techniques; allowing students to impress employers and make their mark within the industry. This course also paves the way for PhD research studies in software engineering and computing-related subjects. A few roles that students may choose to explore upon graduating with an MSc in Software Engineering are:

  • Applications developer
  • Cyber security analyst
  • Game developer
  • Information systems manager
  • IT consultant
  • Multimedia programmer
  • Web developer
  • Web designer
  • Software engineer

The course will help students develop strategic thinking skills demanded of professionals in the global economy today. The Master of Business Administration (MBA) course offers the opportunity to develop students' critical knowledge of organisations, awareness of management and leadership practices and the complex business issues they face. Students will also be able to develop creative and systematic approaches to underlying business issues, and understanding how business and management practices can be improved Being intellectually stimulating and challenging, the course opens up career development opportunities as well as the opportunity to enhance analytical and critical competencies that are highly valued by employers in today’s global economy.

The Master of Business Administration qualification will give graduates the opportunity to explore a global career in a variety of roles wide with financial institutions, technology companies, blue-chip companies and even SMEs.
